xBRIEFInfo.description: Post-#3214 ceremony dial cold-starts rapid for incomplete inputs. Mid-tier hard tasks may start too light and escalate too late, adding turns without recovery. This story makes cold-start depth tier-conditional after telemetry confirms the signature. Frontier cold-start rapid stays; mid and low cold-start standard by default.

plan.title: bug(policy,session): ceremony dial - cold-start rapid may be tier-hostile on hard tasks; make start depth tier-conditional (follows #3214)

narratives.Description: Post-#3214 ceremony dial cold-starts rapid for incomplete inputs. Mid-tier hard tasks may start too light and escalate too late, adding turns without recovery. This story makes cold-start depth tier-conditional after telemetry confirms the signature. Frontier cold-start rapid stays; mid and low cold-start standard by default.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator on a mid-tier model, I want cold-start ceremony depth to match model tier, so that hard tasks begin with enough structure without forcing frontier models into heavier starts.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Edit packages/core/src/policy/ceremony-dial.ts and ceremony-dial.test.ts (and session-start call sites that consume dial selection if needed). First: document or add a read path for dial depth/provisional reasons already recorded at session start (#3214) so operators can audit failed-task depth. If matrix change proceeds: mid/low tier cold-start selects standard; frontier cold-start remains rapid; keep escalate-on-evidence. Unit tests for tier matrix. Optional: measure/log escalation transition overhead. Run pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/policy packages/core/src/session and task check. Cite #3263 in CHANGELOG.md. Do not claim fix without tests matching matrix AC. Composes #3214 #1581 #759.

narrative.Acceptance: Given model tier mid or low and cold-start incomplete inputs, when ceremony dial selects depth, default depth is standard not rapid; frontier cold-start remains rapid unless override.
Given ceremony-dial unit tests, when vitest runs, mid/low cold-start and frontier cold-start matrix cases pass.
Given CHANGELOG [Unreleased], when the PR lands, it cites #3263.
